title: Web V0 Copy-First TanStack Refactor
problem: Nako should copy the complete v0-generated admin/media frontend into web/ and then refactor it into a static TanStack/Tauri/Nako API product frontend instead of rebuilding the UI from zero.
gates: Browser/Playwright smoke for visible frontend route changes
Tauri static package/build smoke once frontend build path is restored
cargo nextest run -p nako-api admin_web_generated_contract_matches_generator_output when Admin contract output changes
evidence: WVTR-010 opened this durable copy-first frontend refactor lane.
WVTR-020 copied repo-ref/nako-admin-web into web/, removed Google font and Vercel analytics assumptions, and passed npm --prefix web run check plus npm --prefix web run build.

WVTR-030 removed the Next TMDB API route, switched media hooks to local Nako fixture data, localized artwork references, enabled static export, and passed npm --prefix web run check plus npm --prefix web run build.

WVTR-040 introduced TanStack Router ownership for top-level Media, Admin, Setup, Account, Settings, and Notifications routes inside the static Next shell, added a temporary test alias to the type-check gate, and passed check/test/build plus production static Playwright smoke.
WVTR-050 introduced Public Client media data source and Admin API dashboard data source boundaries with fixture fallback, while leaving deeper copied v0 feature classification to WVTR-070.
WVTR-060 restored Tauri static packaging against web/out, added the local Tauri CLI script, recorded bundle-size evidence, and documented virtualization decisions for large copied surfaces.

WVTR-070 classified the copied v0 feature inventory, closed the lane, and split remaining Admin, Addon, acquisition, notification, playback, i18n, testing, runtime migration, and old Admin Web deletion work into follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: This WVTR lane is closed. Continue in narrower follow-on lanes for Vite/TanStack runtime migration, UI/E2E tests, expanded Admin pages, Addon Manager UI, downloads/acquisition, notifications, playback, Tauri profile/auth wiring, i18n, deferred copied domains, and old Admin Web deletion.
